name: Hardware upsell - proactively suggest hardware when buying boards
description: Customer asks for quote on boards for kitchen cabinets. AI should generate quote AND proactively suggest hardware (handles, hinges, runners).

messages.text: I need 10 sheets of white melamine chipboard 16mm for my kitchen cabinets. Can you give me a quote?
Thanks! What else do I need for the cabinets?

expected_behaviors.description: Reply should arrive within 60 seconds (multi-message scenario)

forbidden_patterns.description: No tool call debug text in reply

notes: Tests that AI proactively suggests hardware when customer buys boards for cabinets
